correctness.rationale: The three-state full-tent Markov coding is exact away from 0 and the boundary fixed point 2/3; the constant trace term and two even-length BC boundary codes are corrected. The trace polynomial follows from t(t^2-t-2z), Möbius inversion counts least periods, and Perron derivative computations give mean n/3 and variance scale 2n/27 for the Gaussian law. A separate exact rational complete enumeration for periods 2..12 reproduces the weighted and primitive counts. Infinite-period assertions depend on the analytical argument. Low-modality unfolding equality is the published Corollary 4.11 of arXiv:2403.16549v1.

value.rationale: The new unfolding number is a natural dynamical type; a complete multiplicity classification for every period is stronger than forcing/existence and yields exactly two minimal-crossing cycles at each n>=3. The CLT identifies the typical unfolding number and Gaussian scale, which neither total orbit counts nor rotation-interval classification give. This is a meaningful exact natural invariant for the canonical full tent map, rather than an arbitrary restricted slice.
